Title: Server crashes on startup after upgrading to 2.3

cases.description: Review-finding filter positive: real regression in the diff (divide instead of multiply)

request.state:
--- a/billing/total.py
+++ b/billing/total.py
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@ def order_total(items, discount):
     subtotal = sum(i.price * i.qty for i in items)
-    return subtotal * (1 - discount)
+    return subtotal / (1 - discount)

REVIEW FINDING: 'order_total now divides by (1 - discount); with discount=0.5 the total doubles instead of halving, and discount=1 raises ZeroDivisionError.'
